description: Store the bundle contract for a project: input invariants, which are author-declared consistency rules over the ruleset's inputs (for example member.renewal_date must not be before member.joined_date). Every later generation copies them into the compiled ruleset. When a decision's inputs break one, it returns undetermined with undetermined_reason input_errors and a field_errors message for each named field, and asks no further question; an invariant is skipped while any input it reads is missing. Each invariant is {id, expr, error_fields, message}: expr is exactly one comparison (=, !=, <, <=, >, >=) over field references and typed constants, and every error field must be read by it. At most 32 invariants. Replaces any stored contract; omit input_invariants, or pass null or [], to clear it. Field names and types are checked against the project's fields when generation starts. Use a test case's expectations.field_errors to assert the messages.

error_fields.description: Fields that receive the message; each must be read by the expression

expr.description: Exactly one comparison (=, !=, <, <=, >, >=) over field references ({type: "field_ref", key}) and typed constants ({type: "const", sort, value})

message.description: The message shown for each error field

provenance.description: Optional source provenance; checked by the engine

input_invariants.description: Input invariants for the project: consistency rules over the ruleset's inputs, for example member.renewal_date must not be before member.joined_date. Omit, or pass null or [], to clear the stored contract.

name: aethis_set_bundle_contract
